title: Skeleton Queen and Serpents
description: A crowned skeleton queen with long blonde hair sits on a purple wooden throne, resting her skull on her hand. To her left stand five small skeletons holding red flowers, while a large white snake with red eyes coils from the foreground toward a massive, stylized curling wave filled with psychedelic red, purple, and green patterns containing skulls and symbols.
prompt: A crowned female skeleton with long flowing blonde hair sits pensively on a tall purple wooden throne, one hand resting on her skull. Five small white skeletons holding red roses stand in line to the left. A large white serpent with red eyes slithers from the foreground across a wooden floor toward an enormous stylized curling wave that dominates the right side, the wave filled with intricate red, magenta, and green psychedelic patterns containing skulls and symbols, dark wood panel background, surreal macabre scene.
